_about: YouTube channel ids for the creators in the video library (public/data/media/video_library.json). The daily refresh reads each channel's latest uploads and adds the new ones. A channel is only used when its latest uploads overlap the videos already listed for it, so a wrong id is skipped, not added. To add a channel: put its name exactly as in the library's channel list and its channel id (the UC... id in the channel page's address or source).
